essence: Unsetting light holds bright and dark alike; one inward reality bounds both.

sections.SUMMARY: A light that never sets holds brightness and darkness alike; a solitary inward reality, which both bound.

rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya (wonder) at darkness included, never opposed
rasa.justification: The sthāyibhāva is wonder: unsetting light wedding bright and dark. All-containing marvel relished.
